content.text:
I built this list from a single search, so it may be missing some codes. For example, S2406 (closed fracture of the trapezoid) did not appear in the results. I did not run any follow-up searches.

**What I included**
- Distal radius and ulna fractures, both open and closed. This covers Colles', Smith's and Dupuytren's fractures, radial styloid fractures, and fractures of the lower end of the radius and ulna.
- Carpal bone fractures: scaphoid, lunate, triquetral, pisiform, trapezium, capitate, hamate, multiple carpals, and the general carpal-bone codes.
- Wrist fracture-dislocations and fracture-subluxations, since each involves a wrist fracture.
- General wrist fracture codes, such as "Closed fracture of wrist" and "Wrist fracture - open".

**Judgement calls**
- I included S242 (Fracture at wrist and hand level), Syu65 (Fracture at wrist and/or hand level) and S2420 (Fracture of scaphoid bone of wrist). They are broad, and S242 and Syu65 may also cover hand fractures.
- I included the carpometacarpal fracture-dislocation and fracture-subluxation codes (S4C03, S4C23), because they sit under the wrist fracture-dislocation codes.

**What I left out**
- Metacarpal, finger and thumb fractures.
- Proximal radius and radial shaft fractures.
- Procedure codes, history-of codes, sequelae codes, and sprains or dislocations without a fracture.
- Codes for a fractured radius with no site given (S23x1, S23x1-1).

I built this list from a single search, so it may be missing some codes. For example, S2406 (closed fracture of the trapezoid) did not appear in the results. I did not run any follow-up searches.

**What I included**
- Distal radius and ulna fractures, both open and closed. This covers Colles', Smith's and Dupuytren's fractures, radial styloid fractures, and fractures of the lower end of the radius and ulna.
- Carpal bone fractures: scaphoid, lunate, triquetral, pisiform, trapezium, capitate, hamate, multiple carpals, and the general carpal-bone codes.

- Metacarpal, finger and thumb fractures.
